description: Upcoming professional boxing cards worldwide, grouped by card: date, start_utc (card start in UTC), venue, promoter, broadcasters, and each bout with both records going in, division, scheduled rounds, title, Boxerbook forecast and market consensus when known. Use this for "who is fighting tonight / this weekend", "what boxing is on". when=today also keeps last night's cards that started under 6 hours ago. Cite the url of each card or bout.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the bout, e.g. GB, US, MX

division.description: division code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's featherweight)

when.description: today (and cards still running from last night), tonight, weekend (Fri-Sun) or 30d

name: boxing_schedule

p_a.description: Boxerbook model probability that side a wins

opening.description: the opening line (first live snapshot); /v1/bouts/{id} only

p_a.description: no-vig consensus probability of side a

start_utc.description: ISO UTC start of the card, when known

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

truncated.description: true when the 400-bout cap of the underlying list may have dropped bouts of this window (narrow it with country or division)

title: Boxing schedule
